description: Metadata-only reader for the taxpayer's own Buzón SOL
writesNothing: The network path calls folders, alerts and listNotiMenPag only. obtenerDetalleNotiMen is blocked before the visor loads. The only write is a private local snapshot under SUNAT_HOME.

auth.session: Existing SOL session from sunat-cli login
auth.credentials: Clave SOL remains in the OS keychain and is never written to the snapshot

list.description: List message and notification metadata and save a private snapshot

flags.--max-pages: Maximum pages per inbox, integer from 1 to 100, default 25

status.description: Read the last snapshot offline without contacting SUNAT

itemFields.id: Stable local identity composed from kind and SUNAT message code
itemFields.subject: Observed subject with terminal control characters removed
itemFields.sentAtObserved: Raw timestamp observed from SUNAT, not interpreted as a legal date
itemFields.publishedAtObserved: Raw publication timestamp observed from SUNAT
itemFields.validUntilObserved: Raw upstream value preserved as evidence, never treated as a legal deadline
itemFields.stateCodeObserved: Raw upstream state code with no inferred meaning
itemFields.attachmentCountObserved: Observed attachment count; attachments are not opened or downloaded
itemFields.newSincePrevious: True only when a prior local snapshot exists and did not contain this id
